why: Serie «Pregunta de la semana»: fórmula pregunta-dolor del bloque «Qué funciona», con imágenes propias del local. Objetivo: resolver una duda frecuente y generar consultas con la palabra GLOW.

problems: Hook card and caption overlap the woman's face and chin in the first two frames, so text covers a face
Frames 1 and 2 are near-identical (same clip, same hook), so the first 2.5s feels static
Caption 'room, ready for' covers the hook card at 0.8s and the stacked text looks cluttered
Caption fragments like 'series, not a' and 'question.' are split mid-sentence and are hard to follow
Visuals do not match the voice: no laser room establishing shot, and the tattoo-style pen at 11.0s reads as a different trade (tattoo/microblading)
qa.fix: Open with one clear laser-room shot with the hook placed above the face, replace the duplicate handpiece, tattoo-like and pen clips with varied laser hair removal and consultation shots, and keep the captions in full phrases away from faces.
